decisions.geometry: Load the adopted 16-part Xbox One S GLB registered in assets/asset_index.json.
decisions.material: Bind the audited source GLB material for inspection while the visible frame is produced from the user-approved packed Blender/Cycles scene.
decisions.motion: Generate the appearance-kinematics schema 2 profile and evidence under build/generated/kinematics; unsupported physical values remain unknown.
decisions.mapping: Map the standard 21-channel browser state to explicit joints and constraints. This is a kinematic preview, not measured sensor or contact calibration.
decisions.drag: Project picked visible-part motion through the same schema-2 mapping; paired sticks use the shared bounded two-axis solver.
decisions.reset: Immediate kinematic reset or explicit hold; no claim of spring dynamics.
decisions.rendering: CyclesView requests frames from one persistent Blender worker and retains only the latest pending pose.
decisions.server: Loopback only; explicit roots and no directory listing
decisions.harness: tests/test_gamepad_state.mjs, tests/test_viewer_kinematics.mjs, tests/test_drag2d.mjs and tests/browser_viewer_harness.mjs; real-device gate remains separate
